speaker: Bo
text: Na, I want to send these postcards. Where’s the nearest post office? Do you know?

speaker: Na
text: Let me think… Oh, there’s one on Điện Biên Phủ Street. It’s across from the park.

speaker: Bo
text: I also need some cash. Is there an ATM around here?

speaker: Na
text: Sure. There’s one next to the post office.

speaker: Bo
text: OK, thanks, Na. I also need a haircut. My hair is too long.

speaker: Na
text: You can go to the EFTB salon on Trường Sa Street. My uncle cuts hair really well.

speaker: Bo
text: Sounds great! Can you go with me?
